beat.title: Havdar Urges Immediate Evacuation
beat.boundaryReason: Havdar reports the other attack and urges departure at first light; the village and temple begin urgent preparations while Kenzo remains meditating. The next beat begins Delwath's direct approach to Kenzo.
dateEvidence: u3608-u3622 place Havdar's arrival after the battle and call for leaving the next morning.
u3696-u3738 describe packing through the night and replacing the festival's closing feast with evacuation preparations; u3755-u3778 clarify that Kenzo is still at the battlefield.

beat.title: Karawa Empties at Dawn
beat.boundaryReason: Preserves the explicit new-day departure despite the short closing passage: the villagers head west and the party follows the tracks north; includes the session sign-off.
dateEvidence: u3935 explicitly wakes the party at first light the following morning, after the evening established in u3911-u3934.
u3935-u3945 describe the evacuation and the party's northward departure with the rising sun.

Date discrepancy for review: session.yaml lists drEnd 1748-04-06, but drStart 1748-04-04 plus the next-day preparations, overnight festival, and final overnight rest imply departure on 1748-04-07. The manifest has not been changed.
